title: Dive below Waikiki in an Atlantis submarine
description: A boat brings you to a passenger submarine off Waikiki; once aboard, you descend into a cooler, blue world without getting wet. Look through large windows for reef life and the artificial habitats around sunken vessels while the crew explains what you are seeing. The slow movement leaves time to notice small fish as well as the larger shapes outside.
teaser: See Waikiki’s underwater world from a submarine window.
goodToKnow: The outing involves a boat and submarine transfer. Check current duration, fare and boarding requirements.
whyItMightDelightYou: It gives non-divers a rare chance to feel surrounded by the ocean rather than watching it from shore.
